C1621.title: Pudong Police Dismantle Gang Using AI Avatars for Romance Scams
C1621.summary: Since September 2025, the Shanghai Pudong Public Security Bureau received multiple reports where victims encountered 'beauties' on dating apps who were actually AI-crafted virtual avatars, with accounts often operated by male suspects. Pudong police conducted a cross-province operation, arresting 77 suspects and uncovering fraud involving over 10 million yuan.

references.title: Shanghai Police Crack Major Cross-Province Case, Arresting 77 Suspects; Some Victims Were Defrauded of Tens of Thousands of Yuan Monthly
